description: Test coverage for a project — overall and per folder — computed live from the project's test cases (matches the Test Cases screen). Also answers requirement / traceability coverage: pass jira_id (any Jira issue key, e.g. TE-123 — a requirement, user story, epic, ticket or bug) to get that item's test coverage (the test cases linked to it and how many are automated; zero linked cases = uncovered). For a set of requirements, call once per Jira key. A scope with no test cases returns all zeros.

jira_id.description: Optional Jira issue key (e.g. TE-123) — scope coverage to the test cases linked to this requirement / user story / epic / ticket (traceability coverage)

name: tm_get_coverage_summary
title: Get Coverage Summary
